title: Identification of non-synonymous SNPs affecting structure and function of MLH1 and NBN proteins: a computational approach.
authors: Gund, Vaishnavi; Sharma, Siddharth; Chandan, Swet; Garg, Shashank; Singh, Sidhartha
one_liner_zh: 该研究用计算预测SNP对DNA修复蛋白MLH1/NBN结构与功能的影响，涉及蛋白-蛋白对接而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: The genes NBN and MLH1 are critical for DNA repair, and this study aimed to detect and predict the effects of pathogenic single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in their mRNA and protein sequences. An in silico analysis assessed the impact of SNPs on the physicochemical properties, structure, stability, and function of MLH1 and NBN proteins. Results revealed that some SNPs significantly alter protein stability, structure, and binding interactions, potentially impairing DNA repair. Molecular docking studies further indicated disruptions in protein-protein interactions due to specific SNPs. These findings underscore the importance of using in silico methods to predict the functional effects of genetic variations, providing insights that could guide personalized treatments and improve cancer detection.
abstract_zh: 基因NBN和MLH1对DNA修复至关重要，本研究旨在检测并预测其mRNA和蛋白质序列中致病性单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）的影响。通过一项计算机模拟分析（in silico analysis），评估了SNPs对MLH1和NBN蛋白质的理化性质、结构、稳定性及功能的影响。结果显示，某些SNPs显著改变蛋白质稳定性、结构和结合相互作用，可能损害DNA修复功能。分子对接研究进一步表明，特定SNPs导致蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用中断。这些发现强调了利用计算机模拟方法预测遗传变异功能效应的重要性，为个性化治疗提供指导，并有助于改善癌症检测。
